maddeler.e:
تقترعن (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِعْنَ (taqtariʕna) /taq.ta.riʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# تُقْتَرَعْنَ (tuqtaraʕna) /tuq.ta.raʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
